articles.title: NASA’s Artemis II Rocket and Spacecraft Make Their Way to Launch Pad

articles.title: Orbex’s Subsidiary in Denmark to File for Bankruptcy
articles.summary:
Orbex’s Danish subsidiary, Orbital Express Launch ApS, is set to file for bankruptcy, with its facilities officially closing on 20 January and approximately 90 employees losing their jobs. UK-based Orbital Express Launch (Orbex) established its business in Denmark in October 2016. articles.title: Starfish Space wins SDA contract to deorbit satellites
articles.summary:
Starfish Space has won a contract from the Space Development Agency to deorbit satellites in a missile-tracking and communications constellation, evidence that deorbiting services are moving into the mainstream.
